items.title: Nuxt 3.0.0 < 3.4.2 Unauthenticated File Read via vite-node Dev Server
items.summary: Nuxt 3.0.0 before 3.4.2 contains a semi-arbitrary file read vulnerability in the vite-node dev server middleware that allows unauthenticated attackers to read files by supplying an absolute path as the moduleId. Attackers can send GET requests to / nuxt vite node /module/ with an absolute file path to read sensitive system files. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-19.

items.title: Supergateway 2.4.0 through 4.2.2 Cross-Site WebSocket Hijacking via stdioToWs
items.summary: Supergateway 2.4.0 through 4.2.2 contains a cross-site WebSocket hijacking vulnerability in stdio-to-WebSocket mode that allows malicious web pages to connect by bypassing missing Origin header validation. Attackers can open the /message WebSocket from a victim's browser, even against localhost-bound gateways, to initialize an MCP session and invoke wrapped stdio MCP server tools with victim privileges.

More updates to follow shortly.

items.title: Barracuda Networks Email Security Gateway (ESG) Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
items.summary: Barracuda Networks Email Security Gateway (ESG) contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to invoke a configuration-import function and restore a crafted, compatible backup archive, resulting in unauthorized modification of the appliance’s global configuration. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-111560.
